salvo: salvo14/mig/s6 (9 Nov 2026), lot k-openai-1 (b-openai + c-openai). M4Bench: clinical EHR derivation tasks (28 native tasks over MIMIC-IV and eICU), Docker-isolated Codex campaign with GPT 5.4 Mini and GPT 5.5, no-skill versus with-skill. Table 3 'Reward' rows: mean value-column match rate without and with the clinician-reviewed skill (4 measures; the Delta and Improved-tasks columns are kept as notes). CORRECTION of the research file: 'Resolved reasoning effort was medium for every run' belongs to the Claude Code replication (Appendix, Table 29), not to the Codex runs: no effort is written for the GPT rows. Run window: the primary analysis uses runs of release-20260502-codex-v11 and review-rerun-20260504-codex, the follow-up is dated May 6 (HORS FENETRE: before 15 Oct 2026). Route not written. The HTML copy is held in the b-anthropic evidence folder.
